name: projects-tree
description: Tree view for jumping between related project checkouts on disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Roots, maxDepth and rule matching work read-only; actions that shell out to disk paths are limited until the workspace is trusted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The core walks the filesystem through node:fs and cannot operate over vscode-vfs:// virtual filesystems.
